['Peugeot Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Peugeot Deutschland GmbH operates as a subsidiary of Peugeot S.A., a French multinational automotive manufacturer. The company offers a range of vehicles, including passenger cars, electric vehicles, and commercial vehicles. It is also involved in motorsport activities and has a presence in various international markets.

['Wacker Neuson SE '].company_description: Wacker Neuson SE (formerly: Wacker Construction Equipment AG) with headquarters in Munich, Germany, is a manufacturer of construction equipment and compact machines for concrete and construction site technology listed on the stock market. The group includes the product brands Wacker Neuson, Kramer and Weidemann. The family business, founded in 1848, employs around 6,000 people worldwide (2021).
